name: ICT People, Workforce & Organisation Leadership

market_trigger.reason: Senior technology roles repeatedly require multi-disciplinary team leadership, capability building, succession and operating-model decisions in addition to technical strategy.

proof_project: Synthetic higher-education ICT organisation model with role/capability mapping, service-demand versus capacity analysis, skills gaps, succession risk and bounded insource/outsource decision support.
safe_claim_candidate: Designed and deterministically tested a synthetic higher-education ICT organisation model covering capacity, skills, succession risk and insource/outsource decision support.
forbidden_claims: managed the modelled university ICT headcount
personally owned the modelled workforce budget
performed real procurement or outsourcing decisions
held CIO people authority through this lab
kim_personal_evidence_boundary: The lab does not establish Kim's personal headcount, workforce-budget, performance-management, succession, procurement or CIO authority. Any CV/interview claim requires separate Kim-specific evidence plus Ledger approval.
bubbles_capability_boundary: This is organisational capability in Bubbles. It demonstrates local synthetic design and decision-model capability but does not create past personal employment experience.
next: Retain TESTED_LOCAL_DEMONSTRATION as the Bubbles state. Pursue measured organisational/pilot evidence only if a legitimate bounded use case becomes available; keep Kim personal evidence separate.
